security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Turn triangle meshes back into CAD
bundle.longDescription: PyCadSR reads a triangle mesh (STL, OBJ, PLY, OFF, GLB/GLTF, FBX) and rebuilds it as a CAD model: exact planes, cylinders, cones, spheres and tori, equations found by symbolic regression (PySR), and clean B-spline faces for freeform shapes. It exports STEP.
